data_fields.name: attacker_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 (one shared count across three attacker slots)

data_fields.name: min_hp
data_fields.donor_constant: read from data/ai.txt (value not in donor)

data_fields.name: max_dist
data_fields.donor_constant: read from data/ai.txt (value not in donor); flee if player closer than this, else disengage

data_fields.name: hurt_too_much
data_fields.donor_constant: flags blind / crippled / crippled_legs / crippled_arms from data/ai.txt

data_fields.name: min_to_hit
data_fields.donor_constant: read from data/ai.txt (value not in donor)

data_fields.name: threat_rating
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: melee damage (or best weapon max damage, either hand) + armour class; 0 if dead or knocked out

best_idea: A fighter keeps its current target unless the new enemy's threat is strictly higher, and a living attacker outranks every fallback.
decision_why: Keep the strictly-higher threat switch and the living-attacker-first order; count distinct enemies toward MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 instead of slots (the donor double counts); flee gate uses stamina or time, not AP; reject the AP and turn-based parts.
acceptance: In a three-on-one server test a fighter keeps its target until a new enemy's threat is strictly higher, and a second assertion shows no fighter counts more than three distinct attackers, even when one enemy both hits it and hits its ally.
